component.name: Lambent
component.summary: A desktop shell with a bar that shows the live window layout

description.p: Lambent is a desktop shell for Wayland, written in QML. Its bar draws the windows of each screen as they are placed, and its popouts open where the window placement engine puts them, the way windows do.

ul.li: A bar with a live map of the window layout, workspaces, a clock and a system tray
A control center with quick settings for audio, network, Bluetooth and brightness
An application launcher, notifications with a history, and on-screen displays
A lock screen and a PolicyKit authentication prompt
A shell tree in QML that you can copy into your configuration and edit
